DLG-SC-LOC-024-10-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-10-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご参拝のことで、何かお尋ねでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-10-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about your visit to worship?

DLG-SC-LOC-024-10-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-10-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: お賽銭を入れたいのですが、財布に千円札しかありません。ここで百円玉へ崩してもらう必要がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-10-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 賽銭用に千円札を百円へ崩す必要があるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-10-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to make an offering, but I only have a thousand-yen note in my wallet. Do I need to have it changed into hundred-yen coins here?
DLG-SC-LOC-024-10-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you need to change a thousand-yen note into hundred-yen coins for an offering. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-10-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-10-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この窓口では両替をしていません。入れる額を、こちらから百円と決めているわけでもありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-10-001-SHARED-03.translation: We do not exchange money at this counter. Nor do we require the offering to be a hundred yen.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-10-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-10-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 小銭を用意できなければ参拝できないと思っていました。両替のために授与品を買うつもりでしたが、それはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-10-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 小銭必須という思込みを改め両替目的の授与品取得をやめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-10-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought I could not worship unless I had coins ready. I was going to obtain a religious item just to get change, but I will not do that.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-10-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Correct your assumption that coins are essential and abandon obtaining a religious item solely to get change. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-10-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-10-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 授与品を受けることと、お賽銭を入れることは別です。ご自身の考えでお決めください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-10-001-SHARED-05.translation: Receiving a religious item and making a monetary offering are separate matters. Please decide according to your own wishes.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-10-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-10-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 千円札は帰りの交通費にも使います。今ここで全部入れ、帰れなくなるような決め方はしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-10-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 帰路交通費を考え千円全額を入れる選択をしないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-10-001-SHARED-06.translation: I also need the thousand-yen note for my transport home. I will not decide to put all of it in here and leave myself unable to get home.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-10-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will consider your transport home and will not put in the entire thousand yen. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-10-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-10-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 無理のない形でご参拝ください。窓口でお預かりして後から釣銭を渡す対応もしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-10-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please worship in a way that is manageable for you. We also do not take money at the counter and give change afterward.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-10-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-10-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ここで千円を渡して百円だけ入れてもらう方法もないのですね。お札は財布へ戻し、参拝だけして帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-10-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 窓口へ釣銭を求めず札を戻し参拝だけを選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-10-001-SHARED-08.translation: So there is no method where I hand you a thousand yen and have you put in only a hundred yen for me either. I will put the note back in my wallet, worship without making an offering, and go home.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-10-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Do not ask the counter for change; put the note back and choose just to worship. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-10-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-10-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのご希望で結構です。お帰りの際は、ご自身の持ち物をお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-10-001-SHARED-09.translation: That is perfectly fine. Please check your belongings when you leave.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-10-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-10-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 財布をしまいました。今日は小銭がないことを責めず、帰りの費用を確保できたまま静かに参拝します。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-10-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 財布収納と帰路費用保持を確認し小銭なしでも静かに参拝すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-10-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have put my wallet away. Today I will not blame myself for having no coins; I will worship quietly while keeping the money for my journey home.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-10-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that your wallet is put away and your fare home is retained, and say that you will worship quietly even without coins. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-10-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-10-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご参拝ありがとうございます。それでは、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-10-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for visiting to worship. Please have a safe journey home.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-11-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-11-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 何をお持ちになりましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-024-11-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-11-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 公園の入口で鍵を拾いました。自分の鍵と同じ飾りが付いていますが、私の鍵は家にあるので、これは別の方の物です。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-11-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 本人鍵に似た飾り付き鍵を拾ったが本人所有ではないと申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-11-001-SHARED-02.translation: I found some keys at the park entrance. They have the same kind of ornament as my own keys, but mine are at home, so these belong to someone else.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-11-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report finding keys with an ornament similar to your own, but say that they are not yours. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-11-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-11-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 拾った時刻と、詳しい場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-11-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me when you found them and the precise location.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-11-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-11-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 十五分ほど前です。入口のベンチの下にありました。飾りが似ているだけで、持ち主には心当たりがありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-11-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 拾得時刻とベンチ下の場所を述べ持主に心当たりなしと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-11-001-SHARED-04.translation: About fifteen minutes ago. They were under the bench at the entrance. Only the ornament looks similar; I have no idea who owns them.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-11-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State when you found them and that they were under the bench, and say that you have no idea who the owner is. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-11-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-11-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 中を開けたり、どこかの鍵穴に差したりはしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-11-001-SHARED-05.translation: Did you open anything or put them into any keyholes?

DLG-SC-LOC-024-11-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-11-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: していません。誰の家の鍵か調べようとはせず、そのまま袋に入れてここへ持って来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-11-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 鍵を試さず自分の袋に入れて持参した経緯を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-11-001-SHARED-06.translation: No. I did not try to find out whose house they open. I put them straight into a bag and brought them here.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-11-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you did not test the keys and brought them in your own bag. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-11-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-11-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 分かりました。お預かりする内容を記録します。拾った物は鍵三本と飾り一つですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-11-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. I will record what we are taking into safekeeping. You found three keys and one ornament, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-024-11-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-11-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、三本が輪につながっています。飾りの色だけは自分の物と似ていますが、鍵の形までは比べていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-11-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 三本と飾りを確認し色の類似以外の鍵形状は未比較と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-11-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, the three keys are connected to a ring. Only the ornament's color looks similar to mine; I have not compared the shapes of the keys themselves.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-11-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the three keys and ornament, and say that apart from the similar color you have not compared the key shapes. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-11-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-11-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 見た目の似た部分と、比べていない部分を分けて記録します。続いて、届出に関するご希望を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-11-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will record separately the parts that look similar and the parts you have not compared. Next, I will confirm your wishes regarding the report.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-11-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-11-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 自分の鍵は家にあると先に確かめました。この鍵を自分の物として受け取る相談ではなく、拾った場所を伝える届出です。手続きの説明を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-11-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人鍵の在宅確認済みを述べ返還請求でなく拾得届出として説明を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-11-001-SHARED-10.translation: I first checked that my own keys are at home. I am not asking to receive these as my property; I am reporting where I found them. I will listen to the explanation of the procedure.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-11-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you have confirmed your own keys are at home, and listen to the procedure as a finder reporting property rather than claiming its return. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-11-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-11-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 鍵をお預かりします。それでは、記録の担当へご案内します。ご協力ありがとうございました。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-11-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will take the keys into safekeeping. I will show you to the person who handles the records. Thank you for your cooperation. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-12-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-12-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 薬についてのお問い合わせでしたら、薬剤師へおつなぎします。どうなさいましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-12-001-SHARED-01.translation: If your question is about medicine, I will connect you with the pharmacist. What is the matter?

DLG-SC-LOC-024-12-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-12-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 前に受け取った物は丸い粒でしたが、今回は細長いです。袋の名前は同じように見えるので、そのまま飲んでよいか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-12-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 以前と今回の形状差に気付き服用判断に迷うと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-12-001-SHARED-02.translation: The ones I received before were round tablets, but these are elongated. The name on the bag looks the same, so I am unsure whether I can take them as they are.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-12-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you noticed a difference in shape between the previous and current medicine and are unsure whether to take it. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-12-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-12-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 形だけでは、こちらの受付で判断できません。今回の袋と、以前の袋はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-12-001-SHARED-03.translation: The reception desk cannot judge based on shape alone. Do you have both the current bag and the previous bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-024-12-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-12-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 両方持っています。古い袋は空ですが、飲んでいた粒の写真もあります。二つの袋を混ぜずに見てもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-12-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 旧袋新袋と写真を用意し混同せず見てもらいたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-12-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have both. The old bag is empty, but I also have a photo of the tablets I was taking. I would like you to examine the two bags without mixing them up.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-12-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you have prepared both old and new bags and a photo and want them checked without confusion. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-12-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-12-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そのまま薬剤師へお渡しできるよう、お預かりする物を分けましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-12-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us separate the items we will take so that we can pass them directly to the pharmacist.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-12-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-12-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今回の袋はこちら、古い袋は左です。写真は自分の携帯で見せます。似た名前だと思うだけで、同じ薬だとは言い切れません。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-12-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 新旧袋を位置で区別し名前の類似だけでは同一性を断定しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-12-001-SHARED-06.translation: This is the current bag, and the old one is on the left. I will show the photo on my own phone. I only think the names look similar; I cannot say for certain they are the same medicine.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-12-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish the new and old bags by position, and do not assert that the medicines are identical just because the names look similar. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-12-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-12-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 写真も含めて確認を頼みます。今日の分は、もう服用されましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-12-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will ask for the photo to be checked as well. Have you already taken today's dose?

DLG-SC-LOC-024-12-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-12-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだです。朝に形の違いへ気付き、確認してからにしようと持って来ました。その経緯も伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-12-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本日未服用と形の違いへ朝気付いた経緯の伝達を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-12-001-SHARED-08.translation: Not yet. I noticed the difference in shape this morning and brought them here because I wanted to check first. Please pass on that sequence of events too.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-12-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for it to be passed on that you have not taken today's dose and noticed the shape difference this morning. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-12-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-12-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今日の分はまだ服用していないと申し送ります。薬剤師から説明を受けた後、不明な所はその場でお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-12-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will pass on that you have not taken today's dose yet. After the pharmacist explains, please ask about anything unclear on the spot.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-12-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-12-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。何が変わったのかと、袋のどこを見分ければよいかを聞きます。受付の方に飲み方を決めてもらう話ではないですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-12-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 変更内容と袋の見分け方を薬剤師へ質問し受付判断を求めないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-12-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will ask what has changed and which parts of the bags I should look at to tell them apart. I am not asking the receptionist to decide how I should take them, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-024-12-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will ask the pharmacist about the changes and how to distinguish the bags, without seeking a decision from reception. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-12-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-12-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。詳しい確認は薬剤師へ引き継ぎます。それでは、こちらでお待ちください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-12-001-SHARED-11.translation: Correct. I will hand over the detailed checking to the pharmacist. Please wait here. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-13-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-13-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご予約の商品をお受取りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-13-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you here to collect a reserved item?

DLG-SC-LOC-024-13-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-13-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 電話で靴を取り置きしてもらいました。駅の近くのショッピングパークと聞いたので、こちらへ来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-13-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 電話取り置きの靴を駅近くの施設と思い受取りに来たと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-13-001-SHARED-02.translation: I had some shoes held for me by phone. I was told it was the shopping park near the station, so I came here.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-13-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you came to collect shoes held by phone, thinking this was the facility near the station. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-13-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-13-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予約の控えに、店名や支店名はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-13-001-SHARED-03.translation: Does your reservation note show a shop or branch name?

DLG-SC-LOC-024-13-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-13-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 店名は同じですが、控えには南店とあります。ここの看板は中央店ですね。同じ店ならどちらでもよいと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-13-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 控えの南店と看板中央店を比べ支店区別の誤解を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-13-001-SHARED-04.translation: The shop name is the same, but the note says South Branch. The sign here says Central Branch. I thought either would be fine if it was the same shop.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-13-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Compare South Branch on the note with Central Branch on the sign and explain your misunderstanding about branches. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-13-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-13-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 予約を受けた支店へ、受取り場所をご確認ください。こちらから品物があるとはお答えできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-13-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check the collection location with the branch that accepted your reservation. We cannot tell you that the item is here.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-13-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-13-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 南店へ電話します。私が中央店に来たことを伝え、どこに靴が置かれているかを聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-13-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 予約先へ現在地と靴の保管場所を問い合わせると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-13-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will call the South Branch. I will tell them I came to the Central Branch and ask where the shoes are being held.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-13-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will ask the branch holding your reservation about your current location and where the shoes are stored. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-13-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-13-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 先方から、お返事はありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-13-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you had a reply from them?

DLG-SC-LOC-024-13-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-13-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 靴は南店にあるそうです。今日はそちらへ行かず、受取り日を明日に変えられるかも聞いています。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-13-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 南店保管を確認し翌日受取りへの変更を問い合わせ中と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-13-001-SHARED-08.translation: They say the shoes are at the South Branch. I will not go there today, and I am also asking whether I can change the collection day to tomorrow.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-13-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you have confirmed the shoes are at the South Branch and are asking to change collection to tomorrow. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-13-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-13-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 支店名と受取り日をそろえて確認すると、行き違いを避けられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-13-001-SHARED-09.translation: Confirming both the branch name and collection day together helps avoid misunderstandings.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-13-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-13-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 明日の受取りへ変更できました。南店の住所も先方から聞き直したので、今日は買物を続けず帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-13-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 変更承認と先方住所確認を終え本日は帰宅すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-13-001-SHARED-10.translation: I was able to change it to collection tomorrow. I also asked them again for the South Branch's address, so I will go home today rather than continue shopping.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-13-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that the change is approved and the branch address confirmed, and that you will go home today. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-13-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-13-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご予約先と確認できてよかったです。それでは、明日は控えをお確かめのうえお出かけください。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-13-001-SHARED-11.translation: I am glad you could confirm it with the branch you reserved from. Tomorrow, please check your reservation note before setting out. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-14-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-14-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 出発前に、お部屋のことでご確認でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-14-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to check something about your room before departure?

DLG-SC-LOC-024-14-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-14-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日、枕の下に自分のシャツを入れました。今朝、枕を替えてもらった後からシャツが見つかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-14-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 枕交換後に枕下の私物シャツが見当たらないと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-14-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yesterday I put my own shirt under the pillow. Since the pillow was changed this morning, I have not been able to find the shirt.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-14-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that your own shirt from under the pillow cannot be found after the pillow was changed. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-14-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-14-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 寝具の交換担当へ確認します。シャツの色や、ほかの特徴を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-14-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check with the bedding replacement staff. Please tell me the shirt's color and other features.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-14-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-14-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 白い半袖で、胸に小さい青い刺しゅうがあります。ホテルの無地の寝間着ではなく、私が持って来た服です。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-14-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 白半袖と青刺しゅうを示しホテル寝間着と区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-14-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is a white short-sleeved shirt with small blue embroidery on the chest. It is clothing I brought with me, not the hotel's plain sleepwear.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-14-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe the white short sleeves and blue embroidery, distinguishing the shirt from the hotel's sleepwear. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-14-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-14-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お部屋番号と、交換の時にお部屋にいらしたかを伺えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-14-001-SHARED-05.translation: May I ask your room number and whether you were in the room when the bedding was changed?

DLG-SC-LOC-024-14-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-14-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二〇八号室です。朝食で外へ出ていたので、回収されたところは見ていません。混ざったかもしれない、という相談です。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-14-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 部屋番号と朝食で不在だったため回収は未目撃と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-14-001-SHARED-06.translation: Room 208. I was out at breakfast, so I did not see it being collected. I am asking because it may have become mixed in.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-14-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give your room number and explain that you did not witness collection because you were away at breakfast. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-14-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-14-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 見ていない点も含めて伝えます。担当が、回収した寝具の中を確認できると言っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-14-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will pass on that you did not see it as well. The staff say they can check the bedding they collected.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-14-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-14-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。見つかったら刺しゅうを見て確かめたいです。白いというだけで、ほかの方の服を受け取らないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-14-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 白色だけで所有と決めず刺しゅうで確認したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-14-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. If it is found, I would like to check the embroidery. I will make sure not to accept someone else's clothes just because they are white.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-14-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to check the embroidery rather than assume ownership based only on the white color. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-14-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-14-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 青い刺しゅうの白いシャツがありました。こちらで、ご自身の物かご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-14-001-SHARED-09.translation: We found a white shirt with blue embroidery. Please check here whether it is yours.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-14-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-14-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 刺しゅうと内側に付けた名前が一致しています。私のシャツです。受け取ったので、今から荷物へ入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-14-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 刺しゅうと内側名前の一致で本人服と確認し荷物へ収める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-14-001-SHARED-10.translation: The embroidery and the name I put inside both match. This is my shirt. I have received it, so I will put it in my luggage now.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-14-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that it is your clothing by the matching embroidery and name inside, and put it in your luggage. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-14-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-14-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認できて安心しました。それでは、お忘れ物のないようお帰りください。またのお越しをお待ちしております。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-14-001-SHARED-11.translation: I am relieved we could confirm it. Please make sure you leave nothing behind when you go home. We look forward to welcoming you again.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-15-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-15-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 案内図で、何かお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-15-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for something on the guide map?

DLG-SC-LOC-024-15-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-15-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人へ広場の位置を説明したいです。図の上が北なら、この広場は入口の北にあるのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-15-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 図の上を北と見なし広場方角を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-15-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to explain the plaza's location to a friend. If the top of the map is north, then this plaza is north of the entrance, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-024-15-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Treat the map's top as north and ask to confirm the plaza's direction. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-15-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-15-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この図は、入口から見た並びで描いています。上が北という図ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-15-001-SHARED-03.translation: This map shows the arrangement as viewed from the entrance. It is not a map with north at the top.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-15-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-15-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 上が北だと思い込んでいました。友人にはまだ送っていません。方角ではなく、入口からの順番で説明し直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-15-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 図の向きの誤解を認め未送信の説明を入口からの順に変える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-15-001-SHARED-04.translation: I had assumed the top was north. I have not sent anything to my friend yet. I will explain it again using the order from the entrance rather than compass directions.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-15-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Acknowledge your misunderstanding of the map's orientation and change the unsent explanation to the order from the entrance. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-15-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-15-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 入口から来ると、休憩所の次が広場です。図の番号も使えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-15-001-SHARED-05.translation: Coming from the entrance, the plaza is after the rest area. You can also use the numbers on the map.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-15-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-15-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 休憩所が二番で、広場が三番ですね。「北へ」ではなく、「二番の休憩所を過ぎて三番へ」と伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-15-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 休憩所二番から広場三番という順序を文章にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-15-001-SHARED-06.translation: The rest area is number two, and the plaza is number three. Instead of "go north," I will say, "Pass the rest area at number two and head to number three."
DLG-SC-LOC-024-15-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Put the sequence from rest area number two to plaza number three into words. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-15-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-15-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それなら図と合わせて分かります。友人も同じ図をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-15-001-SHARED-07.translation: That will be clear when used with the map. Does your friend have the same map?

DLG-SC-LOC-024-15-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-15-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 同じ図は持っていません。私の説明だけで番号が分かるとは限らないので、この案内図の写真も送ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-15-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人が図を持たないため番号説明と図の写真を合わせて送る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-15-001-SHARED-08.translation: They do not. My explanation alone may not make the numbers clear, so I will also send a photo of this guide map.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-15-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Since your friend does not have the map, send the numbered explanation together with a photo of the map. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-15-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-15-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 写真に現在地の印が入っているか、送る前に確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-15-001-SHARED-09.translation: Before sending it, check whether the photo includes the mark showing your current location.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-15-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-15-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 入口の現在地と二、三の番号が写っています。写真と順番を一緒に送り、ここが北だという説明は取り消します。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-15-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 現在地と番号の写りを確認し北とする説明を取り消す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-15-001-SHARED-10.translation: The photo shows our current location at the entrance and the numbers two and three. I will send the photo together with the sequence and withdraw my explanation that this direction is north.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-15-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check that the photo shows the current location and numbers, and withdraw the explanation that the direction is north. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-15-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-15-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 向きと順番を整理できましたね。それでは、待合せをお楽しみください。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-15-001-SHARED-11.translation: You have sorted out the orientation and order. Enjoy meeting your friend. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-16-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-16-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 着てみた長さは、いかがですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-16-001-SHARED-01.translation: How is the length when you try it on?

DLG-SC-LOC-024-16-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-16-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 右の袖だけ短いようです。左右で長さが違う服なのかと思って、鏡の前で確かめています。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-16-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 片袖が短く見えるため左右差を店員へ相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-16-001-SHARED-02.translation: Only the right sleeve seems short. I am checking in the mirror because I wondered whether the garment has different lengths on the two sides.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-16-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask the shop assistant about the difference between the sleeves because one seems shorter. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-16-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-16-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 右側は、袖口を内側へ一度折った状態になっています。左右を同じ状態へ戻して比べてみましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-16-001-SHARED-03.translation: The right cuff has been folded inward once. Let us return both sides to the same condition and compare.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-16-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-16-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 右だけ折っていました。いったん両方とも伸ばします。服が不ぞろいだったと決める前に見てよかったです。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-16-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 右だけ折っていたと認め両袖を伸ばして比較する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-16-001-SHARED-04.translation: I had folded only the right one. I will straighten both out first. I am glad I checked before deciding the garment was uneven.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-16-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Acknowledge that only the right sleeve was folded, and straighten both sleeves to compare. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-16-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-16-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 左右の長さは、今はいかがでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-16-001-SHARED-05.translation: How are the lengths on the two sides now?

DLG-SC-LOC-024-16-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-16-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 同じ長さですが、指の先まで隠れます。袖を折って着るより、もう一つ小さいサイズも試したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-16-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 左右一致でも指が隠れるため小さいサイズの試着を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-16-001-SHARED-06.translation: They are the same length, but they cover my fingertips. Rather than wearing it with the sleeves folded, I would like to try one size smaller too.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-16-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to try a smaller size because the sleeves cover your fingers even though both sides match. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-16-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-16-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 小さいサイズをお持ちします。胸や肩も窮屈でないか、合わせてお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-16-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will bring the smaller size. Please also check whether the chest and shoulders feel tight.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-16-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-16-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 肩は小さい方も動かせます。ただ、前のボタンを留めると胸が引っ張られます。袖だけでは決められませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-16-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 小サイズの肩可動と胸の張りを分け袖だけでは決定できないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-16-001-SHARED-08.translation: I can move my shoulders in the smaller one too. But when I fasten the front buttons, it pulls across my chest. I cannot decide based on the sleeves alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-16-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish shoulder movement from chest tightness in the smaller size, and say that sleeve length alone cannot decide it. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-16-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-16-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 袖の長さと胸の着心地、どちらも大切ですね。別の形を見ることもできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-16-001-SHARED-09.translation: Both sleeve length and comfort at the chest matter. You can also look at another cut.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-16-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-16-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この二つは今日は買わず、袖が短めで胸に余裕のある別の形を探します。試着した服はお返しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-16-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二サイズを返し袖短め胸余裕の別形を探すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-16-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not buy either of these today; I will look for a different cut with shorter sleeves and more room at the chest. I will return the clothes I tried on.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-16-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will return both sizes and look for another cut with shorter sleeves and room at the chest. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-16-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-16-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お預かりします。それでは、別の形の棚をご案内します。引き続きご覧ください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-16-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will take them. I will show you the shelves with other cuts. Please continue browsing. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-17-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-17-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 映像の説明で、分かりにくい所はありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-17-001-SHARED-01.translation: Was there anything in the video's explanation that was difficult to understand?

DLG-SC-LOC-024-17-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-17-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 途中から見たので、画面に出た作業が問題の原因なのか、解決のための対策なのか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-17-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 途中視聴の作業が原因か対策か分からないと質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-17-001-SHARED-02.translation: I started watching partway through, so I do not know whether the work shown on screen caused the problem or was a measure to solve it.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-17-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the work you saw after starting partway through was the cause or the countermeasure. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-17-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-17-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今の場面は対策の紹介です。最初には、問題が起きた時の場面があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-17-001-SHARED-03.translation: The current scene introduces the countermeasure. At the beginning, there is a scene showing when the problem occurred.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-17-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-17-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 作業をして問題を起こしたという映像ではなかったのですね。終わりだけで原因を友人へ説明するのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-17-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 今場面は対策と理解し終盤だけで原因を友人へ説明しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-17-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it was not a video showing that the work caused the problem. I will not explain the cause to my friend based only on the ending.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-17-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Understand that the current scene is a countermeasure and do not explain the cause to a friend based only on the ending. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-17-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-17-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 同じ映像が繰り返されます。次の冒頭から見れば、順番を追ってご覧になれます。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-17-001-SHARED-05.translation: The same video repeats. If you watch from the start of the next showing, you can follow the sequence.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-17-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-17-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 機械を自分で戻すのではなく、次の回を待ちます。最後まで見たら終了の合図が出ますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-17-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分で機械を戻さず次回を待ち終了の合図を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-17-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will wait for the next showing rather than rewind the machine myself. Is there a signal when I have watched to the end?
DLG-SC-LOC-024-17-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Wait for the next showing without rewinding the machine yourself, and ask about the ending signal. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-17-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-17-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 終了の画面の後、短い間を置いて最初から始まります。入口へ移動しなくても、この席でご覧になれます。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-17-001-SHARED-07.translation: After the ending screen, there is a short pause before it starts again. You can watch from this seat without moving to the entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-17-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-17-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この席で待ちます。メモには、まず起きた問題と、その後の対策を別の行にして書きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-17-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同席待機し起きた問題と後の対策を別行で記録したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-17-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will wait in this seat. In my notes, I would like to put the initial problem and the measures that followed on separate lines.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-17-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will wait in the same seat and want to record the problem and subsequent countermeasures on separate lines. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-17-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-17-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 次が始まりました。冒頭の見出しを見ながら、順番をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-17-001-SHARED-09.translation: The next showing has started. Check the sequence while looking at the opening heading.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-17-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-17-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 最初の問題から見られました。さっき見た作業は後の対策としてつながります。友人には原因と対策を逆に話さず、見終えてから伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-17-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 冒頭から順を追えたと報告し原因対策を逆にせず全編後に友人へ伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-17-001-SHARED-10.translation: I was able to watch from the initial problem. The work I saw earlier connects to it as a later countermeasure. I will tell my friend after watching the whole video, without reversing the cause and the countermeasure.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-17-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Report that you followed the sequence from the beginning, and say that you will tell your friend after watching all of it without reversing cause and countermeasure. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-17-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-17-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ最後までご覧ください。それでは、引き続きご見学をお楽しみください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-17-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please watch through to the end. Enjoy the rest of your visit. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-18-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-18-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 発車案内で、分からない所がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-18-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything in the departure information you do not understand?

DLG-SC-LOC-024-18-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-18-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人が東町へ行く列車に乗ると言っていました。でも、この表示には川原行きとあります。東町行きは別でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-18-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 東町希望なのに川原行き表示のため別列車か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-18-001-SHARED-02.translation: My friend said we would take a train to Higashimachi. But this display says it is bound for Kawahara. Is the train for Higashimachi a different one?
DLG-SC-LOC-024-18-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether it is a different train because you want Higashimachi but the display says Kawahara. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-18-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-18-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 川原は、この案内の終点です。下の停車駅欄に東町があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-18-001-SHARED-03.translation: Kawahara is the final stop shown in this information. Higashimachi is listed among the stops below.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-18-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-18-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 東町が終点でなければ表示に出ないと思っていました。この列車の途中で降りるということなのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-18-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 東町が途中降車駅で終点表示と別と理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-18-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought Higashimachi would not appear on the display unless it was the final stop. So we get off partway along this train's route.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-18-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Understand that Higashimachi is an intermediate stop where you get off, separate from the displayed terminus. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-18-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-18-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。ただし、別の列車と停車駅が同じとは限りません。どの発車時刻をご覧ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-18-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. But other trains do not necessarily have the same stops. Which departure time are you looking at?

DLG-SC-LOC-024-18-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-18-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 十時二十分の列車です。十時十分の行を見ていたので、時刻の行も合わせ直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-18-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 発車十時二十分を指定し誤っていた十時十分の行を修正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-18-001-SHARED-06.translation: The ten twenty train. I had been looking at the ten ten row, so I will correct the time row I am reading as well.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-18-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Specify the ten twenty departure and correct the ten ten row you had mistakenly read. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-18-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-18-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 十時二十分の行には、東町と記載されています。お友達とは車内で合流されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-18-001-SHARED-07.translation: Higashimachi is listed in the ten twenty row. Will you meet your friend on the train?

DLG-SC-LOC-024-18-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-18-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 駅で会ってから一緒に乗ります。友人には「川原行き、十時二十分」と伝え、東町は降りる駅として書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-18-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人との駅合流と列車終点時刻と降車駅を分けて送る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-18-001-SHARED-08.translation: We will meet at the station and board together. I will tell my friend "bound for Kawahara, ten twenty" and write Higashimachi as the station where we get off.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-18-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Send separately that you will meet your friend at the station, the train's terminus and time, and the station where you will get off. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-18-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-18-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 出発時刻と行先を分けて伝えると確認しやすいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-18-001-SHARED-09.translation: Giving the departure time and destination separately makes it easy to check.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-18-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-18-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 返事が来ました。友人も十時二十分を予定しています。途中の東町で一緒に降りることも確認できました。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-18-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 友人の時刻と途中東町で一緒に降りる予定の一致を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-18-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have had a reply. My friend is also planning for ten twenty. We have also confirmed that we will get off together at Higashimachi along the way.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-18-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that your friend's time matches and that you will get off together at the intermediate stop Higashimachi. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-18-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-18-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: そろってご乗車ください。それでは、よいお出かけを。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-18-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please board together. Have a pleasant outing. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-19-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-19-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お二人分のお食事をご用意しましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-19-001-SHARED-01.translation: Shall we prepare meals for two?

DLG-SC-LOC-024-19-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-19-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 席は二人ですが、食事は私だけです。連れは先に食べてきて、飲み物だけ頼めるか聞きたいと言っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-19-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二席利用でも食事は本人のみで連れの飲物だけ利用可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-19-001-SHARED-02.translation: There are two of us seated, but only I am eating. My companion has already eaten and wants to ask whether it is possible to order just a drink.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-19-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that despite using two seats, only you want a meal, and ask whether your companion can have just a drink. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-19-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-19-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 当店では、飲み物だけのご利用もできます。お連れの方は、こちらの飲み物からお選びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-19-001-SHARED-03.translation: We do welcome customers ordering only drinks. Your companion can choose from these drinks.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-19-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-19-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 連れには自分で選んでもらいます。私の分は、このとんかつ定食を一つお願いします。二つにはしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-19-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 連れの選択を尊重し定食を一つだけ注文する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-19-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will let my companion choose for themselves. For me, please bring one of these pork cutlet set meals. Please do not make it two.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-19-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Respect your companion's choice and order just one set meal. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-19-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-19-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 定食一つですね。お連れの方の飲み物は、お決まりになりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-19-001-SHARED-05.translation: One set meal, correct? Has your companion decided on a drink?

DLG-SC-LOC-024-19-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-19-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだ迷っています。私が勝手にお茶と決めず、選ぶ時間を少しもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-19-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 連れが未決定のため本人が勝手に飲物を決めず時間を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-19-001-SHARED-06.translation: They are still deciding. Rather than choosing tea for them myself, could you give them a little time to choose?
DLG-SC-LOC-024-19-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Since your companion has not decided, do not choose a drink for them and ask for time. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-19-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-19-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: もちろんです。定食は先に注文して、飲み物は後で伺えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-19-001-SHARED-07.translation: Of course. We can take the set meal order first and ask for the drink order later.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-19-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-19-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 定食だけ先にお願いします。連れが選んでから追加します。料理を二人で分ける注文とは違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-19-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 定食だけ先に注文し共有食事の注文と区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-19-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please put through just the set meal first. We will add the drink after my companion chooses. This is different from ordering a meal for the two of us to share.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-19-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Order only the set meal first, distinguishing it from a meal ordered for sharing. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-19-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-19-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 定食一つを受け付けました。飲み物が決まったら、お呼びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-19-001-SHARED-09.translation: I have taken the order for one set meal. Please call us when the drink is decided.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-19-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-19-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 連れはリンゴジュースを選びました。一杯追加してください。二人席ですが、定食一つとジュース一杯になりましたね。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-19-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 連れが選んだジュースを追加し二人分の実注文内訳を復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-19-001-SHARED-10.translation: My companion chose apple juice. Please add one glass. Although we have two seats, the order is one set meal and one glass of juice, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-024-19-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Add the juice your companion chose and repeat the actual breakdown of the order for the two of you. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-19-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-19-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、その内容で承りました。それでは、ごゆっくりお過ごしください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-19-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, that is the order we have taken. Please relax and enjoy your time. Excuse me.
